Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: Current pin is reframe4s 5f7152aa, not the old 9a45083 body baseline. The unpublished 842ec9a factor4 native experiment remains a bounded historical pass; fsLR pointwise route qualification is distinct from generic lattice PushAvailability.Estimated. The failed B4 lattice inverse remains unqualified.

Fresh context: Yes: retained inverse / provider qualification.

Next action: Compare exact current published provider/source to the retained factor4 native experiment, then qualify all coverage/reverse/off-node/divergence gates without source overrides. Never transfer pointwise-route acceptance or change tolerances to admit a failed lattice.

Evidence: build.sbt; docs/verification/stp-finish-20260929/u6-native-candidate-factor4/qualification.json; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Objective
Numerical inverses gated on coverage, residuals and divergence.

Authority and inputs
Plan: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity.md (Phase 6 contract). Reader map: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md. References: ~/code/neurotransform (kernel/format parity), ~/code/neurofunctor (graph/operator parity). R packages are references, not APIs to copy.

Owner role and starting seams
transform. Bounded candidates, not reservations; reserve exact paths when beginning.

Prerequisite packets
Native mote blocking edges are authoritative; see docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Estimated case added; gates: coverage >= policy, interior max/p99 within tolerance, zero interior divergence, typed failure otherwise.
2. Checked against ANTs InverseWarp and FSL invwarp fixtures plus the analytic case.

Verification
Bounded sbt batches: <module>JVM/test then <module>JS/test for touched modules; scalafimCompileAll warning-clean.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet plus its owner-local tests/docs. Respect the authority ledger (docs/plans/image-module-unification-hardening.md) and the imageAlgebraBoundaryCheck forbidden names (no SpatialMorphism/Affine3DMorphism/IdentityMorphism/DenseFieldInverse/JacobianField/JacobianMode etc.). Generic transform/warp math belongs in reframe4s, geometry in image4s, linear algebra in Gale; ScalaFIM keeps neuroimaging policy and adapters. Every change compiles and passes on JVM and JS, run in bounded sbt batches (never scalafimTestAll in one shot); keep scalafimCompileAll warning-clean. Stage with explicit pathspecs (concurrent writers share this worktree). No push, release or foreign-store mutation. At handoff attach exact revisions, commands and results, oracle manifest hashes and declared caveats; unresolved criteria keep the packet open.
